solution:
Differentiate each term using the constant multiple, exponential, and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}
f'(x)
&= \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}\left(4e^x+3x^4-x^2\right) \\
&= 4\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}(e^x)
 + 3\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}(x^4)
 - \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}(x^2) \\
&= 4e^x+3(4x^3)-2x \\
&= 4e^x+12x^3-2x.
\end{aligned}
$$
